title: 第二十一章 塑身之法第二十二章 顽童心态
lines: 第二十一章：塑身之法
听到突如其来的笑语，叶重立即转过身，向着声音的来源望去。随即只见叶重的眼瞳，猛的一瞪，脸色惊喜的指着面前的东西。
在叶重的面前，此时正悬浮着两张发黄的兽皮，正是叶重苦寻无果的天火残图。往上看去，却是让得叶重神色一惊，只见在残图的上空处，正飘荡着一道透明的苍老人影。
“嘿嘿，小娃娃，用不着这么害怕吧？不就是一具灵魂体吗，用得着这么吃惊吗？”，透明的老者，笑眯眯的盯着目瞪口呆的叶重，缓缓开口笑道。
虽然刚刚才亲身经历过无比神异的事，但叶重再次看到眼前的鬼魂一般的灵魂体，叶重的心中也是有些发憷，“前辈，可是武盟之主，丹圣石铄前辈？”。
“咦！”，老者闻言先是一愣，随即却是轻笑道：“看来小友，得了一场了不得的造化啊！”。
随即轻轻颔首道：“没错，老夫正是石铄，但丹圣之名老夫愧不敢当！”。
得到石铄肯定的答复，叶重的脸庞也是一喜。
眼前狼狈的只剩一残魂的老者，名石铄乃是一代豪雄。
石铄不仅独自创下，势力遍布元武的大势力武盟。其一手丹术更是出神入化，被世人冠以“丹圣”之名。石铄独创的以阵法为丹基的炼丹之法，更被无数炼丹大家所眼热，争相想拜其为师学习此术。
见到传说中的人物，叶重先是按捺住心中的激动，随即以略带哀求的语气道：“前辈说笑了！晚辈有一事相求，希望前辈能够答应小子的不情之请！”。
盯着叶重看了会，石铄随即却是似笑非笑的轻笑道：“小友是想要这天火图吗？”。
听闻老者的询问，叶重肯定的点了点头，脸色诚恳的道：“那恶龙的一缕残魂，还在小子识海之中时刻干扰着我，企图将小子我再次夺舍。小子需要天火，将那恶龙的那缕残魂彻底焚烧殆尽，否则小子只怕会活的终日都是提心吊胆！”。
叶重也不想对石铄撒谎，但防人之心不可无。
石铄作为元武大陆一代枭雄，自是有自己的追求和抱负，肯定不想死。如果让石铄知道元阳珠的存在，天晓得他会做出什么事。
看着面色诚恳的叶重，石铄却是心中暗叹道：“我这副模样，有这天火图，也是无用。既然这小子是那位前辈的族中之人，将天火残图给他，也算是还了前辈的人情，了那因果，死的也安心了！”。
随即只见石铄手指一指，轻叹道：“老夫残魂之身，活不了多长时间。这天火图给你也好，只是望小友能帮老夫做一件事，将这枚储物戒指交给我那不成器的徒弟，离火尊者石铄！”。
看着向飘来的黑色蟠龙戒指，和那两张泛黄的天火残图。叶重心中一喜，随即接了过来，看了一眼神情淡然的石铄，叶重顿了顿，随即却是将蟠龙戒指递回了过去，并对石铄沉声道：“前辈不用如此悲观，小子有替前辈重塑肉身之法！小子答应前辈，会尽力帮你重塑肉身，以报前辈先前的救命之恩和赠图之情！”。
叶重虽然不是什么烂好人，但对于石铄还是心存感激的，如果当时不是石铄燃烧灵魂本源叫醒自己，只怕自己早就被敖煌给夺舍了。并且叶重，也不想白白受人恩惠。
而且在叶重的心中，对于石铄这等人还是无比敬佩的。石铄宁肯自爆了肉身，也要灭了敖煌这条魔龙的大无畏英雄气概；和为了救自己这个不相干的人，不惜燃烧灵魂本源的舍己精神；洒脱赠图的舍得气概。
这些都让得叶重十分欣赏和钦佩，对于这种人见死不救，叶重自问是做不到。如果人世间缺少了这种豪杰，该是一件多么的憾事。
闻言，石铄先是一愣，淡然的脸庞之上，也是闪过一抹激动，但随即却是感激的对叶重摇头轻叹道：“老夫刚刚燃烧了灵魂本源，时日无多了。估计是等不到，小友替我重塑躯体的那一日了。老夫在这，先谢过小友了！”。
看着眼神之中展露着感激和坦然无畏的石铄，叶重却是轻笑道：“前辈，小子这还有一部固魂炼魂的功法，足以让前辈等到小子替你重塑躯体的那一日。并且我这还有几副用于养魂的丹药的丹方，相信以前辈的丹术，炼制出这些丹药不过小事一桩罢了。凭借那部功法与这些丹药的辅助，就算是要让前辈的魂源全部恢复，也不过是时日的问题罢了！”。
不待石铄言语，叶重直接大声念叨道：“若卵生、若胎生、若湿生、若化生；若有色、若无色；若有想、若无想、若非有想非无想。我皆令入无余涅盘而灭度之，如是灭度无量无数无边众生，实无众生得灭度者于尔所世，无我相、无人相、无众生相、无寿者相。不应住色生心，不应住声香味触法生心，应生无所住心······”。
缓缓听着叶重念出的口诀，只见石铄立即盘腿虚空而坐。

Chapter 21: How to shape your body
Hearing the sudden laughter, Ye Chong immediately turned around and looked towards the source of the sound. Immediately, Ye Zhong's eyes widened and he pointed at the thing in front of him with a look of surprise on his face.
In front of Ye Zhong, two yellowed animal skins were suspended at this moment, which were the remaining pictures of the Sky Fire that Ye Zhong had been searching for to no avail. Looking up, Ye Zhong was shocked and saw a transparent old figure floating in the sky above the broken picture.
"Hey, little baby, there's no need to be so scared, right? Isn't it just a soul body? There's no need to be so surprised?" The transparent old man stared at the stunned Ye Zhong with a smile, and slowly smiled.
Although he had just experienced an extremely magical thing, Ye Zhong saw the ghost-like soul body in front of him again, and Ye Zhong felt a little scared, "Senior, you are the leader of the Martial Alliance, Senior Dan Sheng Shi Shuo?".
"Hey!" When the old man heard this, he was startled for a moment, but then he chuckled and said, "It seems that my little friend has received an incredible blessing!".
Then he gently nodded and said: "Yes, I am none other than Shi Shuo, but I am not worthy of the name of Alchemy Saint!".
After receiving Shi Shuo's affirmative reply, Ye Zhong's face also lit up with joy.
The old man who was in such a miserable state with only the remains of his soul in front of him was named Shi Shuo, a hero of his generation.
Shi Shuo not only created it alone, but his influence spread throughout Yuanwu's powerful martial alliance. His alchemy skills were so superb that he was dubbed the "Sage of Alchemy" by the world. Shi Shuo's original method of alchemy, which uses formations as the basis of alchemy, is even more popular among countless alchemy masters, who all want to learn this technique from him.
Seeing the legendary character, Ye Zhong first suppressed the excitement in his heart, and then said in a slightly pleading tone: "Senior, you are joking! I have something to ask of you, I hope you can agree to my unkind request!".
After staring at Ye Zhong for a while, Shi Shuo then chuckled slightly and said, "Do you want this Sky Fire Picture?"
Hearing the old man's inquiry, Ye Zhong nodded affirmatively and said with a sincere face: "The remnant soul of the evil dragon is still disturbing me in my sea of ​​consciousness, trying to take away my body again. I need the fire from the sky to completely burn the remnant soul of the evil dragon, otherwise I am afraid that I will live in fear all day long!"
Ye Chong didn't want to lie to Shi Shuo, but he had to be on guard against others.
As a great hero of the Yuanwu Continent, Shi Shuo certainly has his own pursuits and ambitions, and he definitely doesn’t want to die. If Shi Shuo knew about the existence of Yuanyang Pearl, God knows what he would do.
Looking at Ye Zhong with a sincere expression, Shi Shuo secretly sighed in his heart: "With my appearance, it is useless to have this Sky Fire Map. Since this boy is a member of that senior's clan, giving him the Sky Fire Remnant Map can be regarded as repaying the favor of my senior. After knowing the cause and effect, I will feel at ease when I die!".
Immediately, Shi Shuo pointed his finger and sighed: "I can't live long with my remnant soul. It's okay to give you this Sky Fire Map. I just hope that you can do one thing for me. Give this storage ring to my incompetent disciple, Master Lihuo Shi Shuo!"
He looked at the black dragon ring floating toward him and the two yellowed fragments of sky fire. Ye Zhong felt happy and immediately took it. He glanced at Shi Shuo who had an indifferent expression. Ye Zhong paused, then handed the Panlong ring back to him and said in a deep voice to Shi Shuo: "Senior, you don't have to be so pessimistic. I have a way to reshape your body! I promise you that I will try my best to help you reshape your body in repayment for your life-saving grace and gift of the picture!"
Although Ye Zhong was not a bad person, he was still grateful to Shi Shuo. If Shi Shuo hadn't burned his soul source to wake him up at that time, he might have been killed by Ao Huang. And Ye Chong didn't want to receive favors in vain.
And in Ye Zhong's heart, he still admired people like Shi Shuo extremely. Shi Shuo's fearless heroic spirit was willing to blow up his body to destroy the dragon Ao Huang; his self-sacrifice spirit of burning the origin of his soul in order to save himself, an unrelated person; and his free and easy spirit of willingness to give away pictures.
All of these made Ye Zhong appreciate and admire him very much. Ye Zhong asked himself that he couldn't do this kind of people without saving them. What a pity it would be if there were no such heroes in the world.
Hearing this, Shi Shuo was stunned for a moment, and a touch of excitement flashed across his indifferent face, but then he shook his head gratefully to Ye Zhong and sighed softly: "I just burned the soul source, and my time is running out. I guess I can't wait until the day when my little friend can rebuild my body for me. I'm here, I want to thank my little friend first!"
Looking at Shi Shuo, who showed gratitude and fearlessness in his eyes, Ye Zhong chuckled and said: "Senior, I have a soul-solidifying and soul-refining technique, which is enough for senior to wait until the day when I can reshape your body. And I have a few more for you. Regarding the elixirs for nourishing the soul, I believe that it is only a matter of time to refine these elixirs using the elixir skills of my predecessors. With the help of that technique and these elixirs, it will only be a matter of time to restore all the soul sources of my predecessors!"
Without waiting for Shi Shuo to speak, Ye Zhong directly chanted loudly: "If it is born from an egg, if it is born from a womb, if it is born from moisture, if it is born by transformation; if it has color, if it has no color; if there are thoughts, if there are no thoughts, if there are no thoughts, it is not without thoughts. I will make them all enter nirvana without any residue, and they will be annihilated, like this The annihilation of countless and boundless sentient beings. There are really no living beings that can be annihilated in your world. There is no self, no one, no living beings, and no life. The mind should not dwell in color, the mind should not dwell in sound, fragrance, touch, and Dharma. The mind should have no dwelling..."
Slowly listening to Ye Zhong's chanting, Shi Shuo immediately sat cross-legged in the air.
